description: WESTERN PORT 10% AEP 0.2M SLR INUNDATION (series on South Australian Government Data Directory) is a series of datasets listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Energy, Environment and Climate Action. The Western Port Local Coastal Hazard Assessment (LCHA) provides information on the extent of coastal hazards and their physical impacts for the Western Port coastal environment. Information has been collected on inundation hazards (storm surge and catchment inflows) using modelling for different sea level rise scenarios. Coverage: South Australia. The portal lists 6 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Energy, Environment and Climate Action. Its tags are atmosphere, meteorology, Climatology, Environment, Geoscientific information. It offers 7 resource(s) in dwg, dxf, extended tab, gdb, mif. The portal shows 2026-09-07 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
